xray-1912.credit_line: X-ray of Roosevelt showing the bullet, 1912. Lettered on the plate: taken by G. W. Hochreim M.D. Bain News Service; white tape patches cropped from the right edge. Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
xray-1912.note: The plate is lettered X-RAY OF ROOSEVELT, carries a mirror-reversed negative number 2444-2 at the top left, and is signed 'Taken by G. W. Hochreim M.D.' at the bottom left. Cropped to remove white tape patches at the top right and bottom right and the light strip down the right edge; the annotations and the signature are kept. Shared by the Health and Guns and Gear quizzes - both credits now match.
